title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Tier Schedule: Qualifying Spend, Tier Term and Upgrade Bonus
content:
The Finch Circle Loyalty Program has six tiers, from Finch Circle Member (rank 1) to Finch Circle Icon (rank 6). This schedule sets, for every tier, the qualifying spend that earns it, how long an earned tier is held, how far a member can fall at one annual review, how quickly a mid-year upgrade is applied, the one-time upgrade bonus, and whether the tier can be granted as a card status floor.

## Schedule

| Tier | Rank | How the tier is entered | Qualifying spend threshold (USD) | Tier upgrade bonus (points) | Can be granted as a card floor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | 1 | Enrollment (minimum age 13) | 0.00 | 0 | No |
| Finch Circle Silver | 2 | Qualifying spend | 500.00 | 500 | No |
| Finch Circle Gold | 3 | Qualifying spend, or card floor from Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite or Marlowe & Finch Platinum Mastercard | 1200.00 | 1000 | Yes |
| Finch Circle Platinum | 4 | Qualifying spend, or card floor from Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard | 2500.00 | 2000 | Yes |
| Finch Circle Diamond | 5 | Qualifying spend | 5000.00 | 3000 | No |
| Finch Circle Icon | 6 | Qualifying spend | 15000.00 | 5000 | No |

The following terms are the same at every one of the six tiers:

| Term | Value at every tier |
|---|---|
| Tier valid through | the end of the following calendar year |
| Largest number of tiers a member can move down at one annual review | 1 |
| Business days within which a mid-year tier upgrade is applied | 2 |

## What each column means

- **Qualifying spend threshold** — the calendar-year net qualifying spend that earns the tier, in USD to 2 decimals.
- **Tier valid through** — how long an earned tier is held: through 31 December of the calendar year after the year in which it was earned.
- **Largest move down at one review** — the largest number of tiers a member can move down at one annual review, in whole tiers.
- **Mid-year upgrade timing** — the business days after the qualifying purchase posts within which a mid-year tier upgrade is applied.
- **Tier upgrade bonus** — bonus points posted once when a member is upgraded into this tier during a calendar year, in whole points.
- **Can be granted as a card floor** — whether this tier can be granted as a floor by holding a qualifying Marlowe & Finch card status.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical figures)

- A member whose calendar-year qualifying spend reaches 1200.00 has reached the Finch Circle Gold threshold; at 1199.99 the highest threshold reached is still Finch Circle Silver's 500.00.
- A tier earned during a hypothetical year 2027 is held through 31 December 2028.
- A member moving up into Finch Circle Platinum during a calendar year receives that tier's bonus of 2000 points once; a member upgraded into Finch Circle Silver receives 500.
- Only Finch Circle Gold and Finch Circle Platinum carry "Yes" in the card floor column; no other tier can be granted as a card floor.
